changes: First release: Granula, a granular synth machine in the track's machine list.
Every note plays a cloud of grains from the track's sample: POS, SPRD, SIZE and DENS shape it.
MODE plays the grains forward, reversed, or each either way at random.
Grain density follows the tempo and the track's speed.
With the base's linked voices (SETTINGS > VOICES), each note plays its own cloud on its own track.
